text: At 79 minutes, Westport Albion pulls their defensive line deeper toward their own goal at the right end of the pitch, reducing pressure on Kingsmoor FC's attack. They slow the game, dropping tempo and allowing fewer aggressive challenges, holding their shape in a tighter area near their penalty box. Kingsmoor FC pushes up on the left and right flanks, increasing ball presence closer to the Westport goal and trying wide crosses, but Westport keeps their shape to protect their 3-2 lead[#1459].
